name: SVO Vertex and Edge Determination
aliases: SVO Node Bounding Box Vertex/Edge Computation
definition: An algorithm to compute the 8 vertices and 12 edges of each SVO node's bounding box and identify the neighboring node indices for each vertex and edge to facilitate mesh generation.
summary: SVO Vertex and Edge Determination computes bounding box geometry and neighbor indices for mesh generation, differing from sibling methods by focusing on geometric topology rather than data access.
